te: Spanish victory at the Battle of Alcântara brings about the Iberian Union.
dz: 葡萄牙继承之战:西班牙在阿尔坎塔拉战役的胜利带来了伊比利亚联盟.
de: War of the Portuguese Succession: Spanish victory at the Battle of Alcântara brings about the Iberian Union.

dz: 英军中幸存时间最久的炮兵连(英语:Honorable Artillery Company),也是第二高的一等兵团被组建.
de: The Honourable Artillery Company, the oldest surviving regiment in the British Army, and the second most senior, is formed.

t: 腓力三世虽然患有痢疾,但在父亲路易九世去世后,在第八次十字军东征期间成为了法国国王. 他的叔叔…
te: Philip III, although suffering from dysentery, becomes King of France following the death of his father Louis IX, durin…
dz: 腓力三世虽然患有痢疾,但在父亲路易九世去世后,在第八次十字军东征期间成为了法国国王. 他的叔叔那不勒斯的查理一世被逼同穆罕默德一世·穆斯坦西尔,突尼斯的哈夫西德苏丹开始和谈.
de: Philip III, although suffering from dysentery, becomes King of France following the death of his father Louis IX, during the Eighth Crusade. His uncle, Charles I of Naples, is forced to begin peace negotiations with Muhammad I al-Mustansir, Hafsid Sultan of Tunis.

t: 摄政乔治·穆扎隆和他的兄弟在迈克尔八世·帕莱奥洛戈斯领导下的贵族派系所领导的政变中被杀死,为它…
te: Regent George Mouzalon and his brothers are killed during a coup headed by the aristocratic faction under Michael VIII …
dz: 摄政乔治·穆扎隆和他的兄弟在迈克尔八世·帕莱奥洛戈斯领导下的贵族派系所领导的政变中被杀死,为它的领袖最终篡夺尼卡埃亚帝国的王位铺平了道路.
de: Regent George Mouzalon and his brothers are killed during a coup headed by the aristocratic faction under Michael VIII Palaiologos, paving the way for its leader to ultimately usurp the throne of the Empire of Nicaea.

t: 荷兰奥姆门市接收乌得勒支大主教奥托三世授予的城市权利和强化权.

dz: 荷兰奥姆门市接收乌得勒支大主教奥托三世授予的城市权利和强化权.

de: Emperor Constantine V humiliates nineteen high-ranking officials, after discovering a plot against him. He executes the leaders, Constantine Podopagouros and his brother Strategios.

te: Roman Emperor Gratian is murdered at a banquet after having surrendered to the forces of rival emperor Magnus Maximus.
dz: 罗马皇帝格拉提安在向对手皇帝马格努斯·马克西穆斯(英语:Magnus Maximus)的军队投降后在宴会被谋杀.
